newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan 1st 10 days trade deficit 463.60 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan 1st 10 days trade deficit 463.60 bln yen.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade was in deficit by 463.60 billion yen in the first 10 days of January, widening by 16.8 percent from a revised deficit of 396.93 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 47.4 percent from a year earlier to 578.08 billion yen while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 32.0 percent to 1.04 trillion yen.
